---
subtitle: "EUROPEAN CAUSAL INFERENCE MEETING</br> Practical Information"
---

(a) The conference rooms are located on the 1st and 3rd floors of the building. You are encouraged to use the stairs to access them. Please wear appropriate footwear.

(b) The seating in the conference rooms is not very comfortable! We advise sensitive attendees to bring a small cushion, as at the opera.

(c) Remember to bring a reusable water bottle.
